code:
from sklearn.inspection import permutation_importance

result = permutation_importance(
    model, X_test, y_test,
    n_repeats=30,
    random_state=42,
    scoring="roc_auc",
)

ranked = sorted(
    zip(X_test.columns, result.importances_mean),
    key=lambda t: -t[1],
)
caption: Permutation importance shuffles one feature at a time and measures the out-of-sample performance drop — model-agnostic and harder to fool than MDI.
